## Checklist

- [ ] `make check` passes locally.
- [ ] Tests cover the change (unit, plus integration for anything that touches I/O), and coverage gates hold.
- [ ] Documentation that describes the change is updated in this pull request, with Mermaid diagrams where needed.
- [ ] Choices between real alternatives are recorded as ADRs; out-of-scope items are in `docs/BACKLOG.md`.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, `.env` content, or organizer data anywhere in the diff.
- [ ] No emojis in code, docs, UI copy, logs, test names, fixtures, or commit messages.
- [ ] No AI attribution in commits, the pull request, docs, or code comments.
- [ ] Commits follow Conventional Commits, one logical change each.
